title: MCQ: What does this print?

tests.name: D D
tests.code:
String out = CjTestBase.capture(() -> Solution.program());
CjTestBase.checkTrue(out.startsWith("D"), "the chosen option's explanation (starts with the letter)");
tests.hint: D. Strings are immutable and the parameter is a copy of the reference: addBang rebinds its LOCAL s to a new object; the caller's t still points at "ready". A student picking A believed mutation escapes the method; B confuses the parameter with the result; it compiles fine.
